entities.summary: Konstantin Fyodorovich Yuon or Juon was a Russian painter and theatre designer associated with Mir Iskusstva. Later, he co-founded the Union of Russian Artists and the Association of Artists of Revolutionary Russia. Konstantin Yuon was a painters & sculptors from Moscow (1875-10-24, Moscow–1958-04-11). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
